failures.symptom: A clean diagram hides missing runtime or ownership reality.
likely_causes: Architecture modeled from intended design only.
repair_path: Downgrade to intended architecture and recover observed architecture separately.

failures.symptom: Architecture adds shared services/platform coupling before justified need.
likely_causes: Preference for uniformity over bounded ownership.
checks: Check blast radius, dependency depth, operational burden, reversibility.
repair_path: Prefer simpler/local boundary or record explicit justification.
